_comment: Web-play demo manifest (docs/PLAN-webui-demo-fbf243.md §5). COPY (labels, order, matchups, sims, blurbs, source detail) is hand-authored and reviewed in git; the identity guards (gameType/boardWidth/boardHeight/winLength) plus bytes/rawBytes/sha256/model/source.canonical are STAMPED by scripts/build-demo-bundle.sh from web/demo/curation-pins.json + the built models. Re-running the build never clobbers copy.

games.label: Tic-Tac-Toe
games.blurb: 30M-cycle NEAT champion. Tic-Tac-Toe is solved, so it plays perfectly — draw it if you can.

source.detail: Solved game, BvH trivially saturated (no ttt-*-sweep.csv). Pinned champion the dev app ships; documented BvH exception (§3.1). NEAT_POPULATION v4 — neatMember pins the champion member post-load. No heuristic opponent (supportsHeuristic:false).

games.label: Connect 4
games.blurb: AlphaZero-lite Connect 4 net (99% vs the built-in heuristic). Try to force a threat it can't parry.

source.detail: BvH champion==bvh row, 7x6/win-4, saves/connect4-alphazero-ts100-steps100-sweep.csv. ALPHAZERO (NEAT-genome AZ, already fixed-topology), NOT a CNN. rc500k (99.5% @ 48.7MB) excluded as within-noise and larger (§3.4).

games.label: Othello
games.blurb: 7x64 AlphaZero-lite, ship-certified ~OLIVAW-class Othello net (beats Edax L8; 0.625 score vs L10).

source.detail: BvH saturated for Othello (net beats the ply-8 Strong heuristic) -> ranked on the Edax ladder. Gate C1-b DEPLOY (docs/BRIEF-c1-5-online.md section 9.3): one-shot ship read on the reserved 1000-opening ship-confirm slice, L9/L10 @ sims=12800, opening-clustered paired bootstrap against the C1 champion it replaces -> pooled +0.0693 score [+0.0534, +0.0850] at 95%, neither level a loss. Absolute L10 score 0.625. Do NOT bundle othello-az-cnn7x64-edaxopp-L6 (~207MB, weaker).

games.label: Hex
games.blurb: cnn5x48 AlphaZero-lite on tournament-standard 11x11 Hex (99.5% vs the built-in heuristic).

source.detail: BvH champion==bvh row, 11x11, saves/hex-alphazero-11x11-rc500k-ep100-cnn5x48-sweep.csv. ALPHAZERO_CNN. Ships REPLAY-BUFFER-STRIPPED: 280MB canonical -> ~36MB raw / ~11.4MB zst (§3.1). Size-viable non-CNN 11x11 nets are unusable (1.5% BvH).

games.label: Gomoku
games.blurb: cnn5x48 AlphaZero-lite on 11x11 freestyle Gomoku (win-5) — 100% vs the built-in heuristic.

source.detail: BvH champion==bvh row, 11x11/win-5, saves/gomoku-alphazero-11x11-lr0p0003-rc500k-ep100-cnn5x48-sweep.csv. ALPHAZERO_CNN. Ships REPLAY-BUFFER-STRIPPED: 269MB canonical -> ~37MB raw / ~11.7MB zst (§3.1).
